clock: Exact frozen market calendar, entry session included in horizon; no compression over missing ETF quotes
entry: Hypothetical fresh acquisition at specified raw open; empty pre-existing cash/receivable/units before entry
endpoint: Raw close valuation on specified final market session; no actual sale, fees, withholding, slippage, interest or reinvestment
entitlement: Entry < ex_date <= exit; use physical units after splits strictly after entry through ex_date. Pay_date <= exit means settled cash; otherwise receivable. Pre-entry entitlement never transfers to buyer.
split: Entry < split_date <= exit changes units by official ratio; entry on split date buys post-split units, so do not split them again.
missing_policy: Fail closed for unknown/unquoted/nonmarket boundaries, unsupported instrument, coverage violations, malformed dates or changed source bytes. Retain every attempted fixed-horizon window with status; never move endpoints or fill missing endpoint prices.
scope: All market entry sessions times both frozen horizons, including rejected tails and unquoted endpoints; exhaustive correctness audit, not selected trading dates or model evaluation
implementation: Reuse prior physical_ledger; independent Decimal closed-form entitlement sum and independent complete-cohort enumeration
acceptance: All retained statuses and endpoint identities agree; accepted terminal accounts agree <=1e-8 TWD; corruption/missing provenance rejected
